about: fk-domains' application mutants (plan §20.6); each is judged by the example's tests, laws and cases (scripts/examples), not by a compiler test.

mutants.name: fd1-offset-twice
mutants.to:
let skip = if from+from < to { from + from } else { to }
	for t in domains.Catalog[skip:to] {
mutants.rule: A page is the items offset to offset+limit of the whole answer (law PageIsSliceOfWhole).

mutants.name: fd1-featured-out-of-order
mutants.rule: The featured TLDs come first in the original's order (WireAgreesWithOrigin, case search-top).

mutants.name: fd1-1025-accepted
mutants.rule: A body of 1,025 bytes is 413 (WireAgreesWithOrigin, 20-exactly-1025).

mutants.name: fd1-1024-refused
mutants.rule: A body of 1,024 bytes is answered (WireAgreesWithOrigin, 19-exactly-1024).

mutants.name: fd1-no-store-missing
mutants.rule: Every answer of the endpoint carries Cache-Control: no-store (WireAgreesWithOrigin).

mutants.name: fd1-upper-label
mutants.rule: An upper-case label does not decode (WireAgreesWithOrigin, 11-upper; case not-a-label).

mutants.name: fd1-zero-limit
mutants.from: type Limit int where 1 <= it && it <= 556
mutants.to: type Limit int where 0 <= it && it <= 556
mutants.rule: A limit of 0 does not decode (WireAgreesWithOrigin, 14-zero-limit).

mutants.name: fd2-cache-cut-drops-settled
mutants.to:
case Settled[V]:
			Cache[K, V]{..c, entries: c.entries.Delete(k), recent: without(c.recent, k)}
mutants.rule: A cut ends a load only; a settled entry stays (law CacheFollowsModel).

mutants.name: fd2-cache-cap-plus-one
mutants.rule: At most the capacity's entries are settled (law AtMostCapSettled).

mutants.name: fd2-cache-fresh-at-the-edge
mutants.rule: A value is fresh only while its age is below the freshness (law FreshInsideTheWindow).

mutants.name: fd2-cache-hit-renews-freshness
mutants.from: return Got[K, V]{Cache: Cache[K, V]{..c, recent: without(c.recent, k).Append(k)}, Look: Fresh[V]{Value: s.Value}}
mutants.rule: A hit changes the recency, never the freshness (law HitKeepsFreshness; the model's RenewOnHit).

mutants.name: fd2-cache-pending-evicted
mutants.from: entries: entries, recent: without(c.recent, k), next: c.next + 1}
mutants.to: entries: entries, recent: without(c.recent, k).Append(k), next: c.next + 1}
mutants.rule: A pending entry is never evicted (law PendingNeverEvicted).

mutants.name: fd2-cache-hit-keeps-recency
mutants.from: Cache: Cache[K, V]{..c, recent: without(c.recent, k).Append(k)}, Look: Fresh
mutants.rule: A hit makes the entry the most recent; the least recent goes (law EvictsLeastRecent).

mutants.name: fd2-cache-late-settle-taken
mutants.rule: The answer of a replaced load changes nothing (law LateSettleRejected; the model's NoGen).

mutants.name: fd2-cache-cut-reuses-gen
mutants.to: Cache[K, V]{..c, entries: c.entries.Delete(k), next: c.next - 1}
mutants.rule: A load after a cut has a new generation (law CutThenBeginIsNewGeneration; the model's KeepPending).

mutants.name: fd2-route-length-not-printed
mutants.rule: A route survives its URL (law ParsePrintRoundTrips).

mutants.name: fd2-route-available-dropped
mutants.rule: A parsed URL prints to a URL that parses the same (law PrintParseIsCanonical).

mutants.name: fd2-route-invalid-tld-kept
mutants.rule: An invalid parameter is its default (law InvalidParamIsDefault).

mutants.name: fd2-route-unknown-path-lands
mutants.rule: Every path but the root is NotFound (law UnknownPathIsNotFound).

mutants.name: fd2-window-short-of-viewport
mutants.rule: Every row the viewport cuts is in the window (law WindowCoversViewport).

mutants.name: fd2-window-grows-with-count
mutants.rule: The window is bounded for every count, and its work is flat (laws WindowIsBounded, StepWorkIsFlat).

mutants.name: fd2-window-spacer-short
mutants.rule: The spacers and the rows are the list's height (law SpacersSumToTotal).

mutants.name: fd2-window-overscan-wobbles
mutants.from: let over = if s.Overscan < 0 { 0 } else { s.Overscan }
mutants.to: let over = if s.Overscan < 0 { 0 } else { s.Overscan + 1 - top%2 }
mutants.rule: Scrolling down never moves an edge of the window up (law WindowIsMonotone).

mutants.name: fd2-plan-ranges-overlap
mutants.from: return Range{Offset: TopCount(), Limit: end - TopCount()}
mutants.to: return Range{Offset: TopCount() - 1, Limit: end - TopCount() + 1}
mutants.rule: A range never overlaps the one before (law RangesNeverOverlap).

mutants.name: fd2-plan-stops-at-half
mutants.rule: The plan loads every listing the window shows (law PlanCoversWindow).

mutants.name: fd2-plan-top-five
mutants.rule: A cold search asks for {0,4} then {4,56} (law FirstIsFourThenFiftySix).

mutants.name: fd2-plan-price-pages
mutants.rule: A price order loads the whole catalog in one range (law PriceOrderLoadsWhole).

mutants.name: fd2-plan-asks-loaded-again
mutants.rule: The plan asks for no range twice and ends (law PlanEnds).

mutants.name: fd2-plan-steps-grow
mutants.rule: The planner's work does not grow with the catalog (law StepWorkIsFlat).

mutants.name: fd3-nogen
mutants.rule: The model's NoGen: an answer is taken only for the load the cache waits on (ShownBelongs; story: a canceled query cannot restore old results).

mutants.name: fd3-bylabel
mutants.rule: The model's ByLabel: an answer of the current label but an old load is not taken (ShownMonotone).

mutants.name: fd3-nodebounce
mutants.rule: The model's NoDebounce: no request starts inside the 150 ms of a key (NoWastedRequest, BurstMakesOneSearch).

mutants.name: fd3-renew-on-hit
mutants.to:
let b = cache.Begin(at.Cache, ck)
		Planned{State: fill(Search{..at, Cache: cache.Settle(b.Cache, ck, b.Gen, f.Value, t)}, r, f.Value), Effects: []Effect{}}
mutants.rule: The model's RenewOnHit: a hit keeps the entry's freshness (FreshBound; story: fresh results expire one minute after completion even after reuse).

mutants.name: fd3-keep-pending
mutants.from: Cache: cache.Cut(s.Cache, ck), InFlight: None}, Effects: []Effect{Cancel{Key: k.Value}}}
mutants.to: Cache: cache.Cut(s.Cache, ck+"-"), InFlight: None}, Effects: []Effect{Cancel{Key: k.Value}}}
mutants.rule: The model's KeepPending: a cut load's entry goes, so the label is fetched again (SettledShows).

mutants.name: fd3-index-on-scroll
mutants.rule: A scroll or a resize never builds the index again (target P3; law ScrollKeepsIndex).

mutants.name: fd3-cart-cleared
mutants.rule: A new query keeps the cart (story: cart additions are unique and removals are idempotent, across queries).
